# Kering

> > Global luxury group managing prestigious Houses including Gucci, Bottega Veneta, Saint Laurent, Balenciaga, Alexander McQueen, and Brioni, with leadership in sustainable fashion and climate innovation.

Kering is a multinational luxury goods conglomerate headquartered in Paris, managing a portfolio of renowned fashion and leather goods Houses. The company is recognized for pioneering sustainability initiatives in luxury fashion, including its Environmental Profit & Loss methodology and Regenerative Fund for Nature.

## Key Topics

- Gucci
- Bottega Veneta
- Saint Laurent (Yves Saint Laurent)
- Balenciaga

## Sustainability & Climate Action

- [Climate change adaptation strategy](https://www.kering.com/en/sustainability/mitigating-climate-change/climate-strategy): Climate strategy: science-based targets aligned with Paris Agreement
- [Regenerative Fund for Nature](https://www.kering.com/en/sustainability/safeguarding-the-planet/regenerative-fund-for-nature): Kering & Conservation International's Regenerative Fund for Nature initiative
- [Sustainability: our publications and videos](https://www.kering.com/en/sustainability/news-and-resources/publications-and-videos): Sustainability publications, videos and reports by Kering leadership
- [Volcom launches EP&L to reduce emissions, waste and water usage](https://www.kering.com/en/news/volcom-launches-epl-reduce-emissions-waste-water-usage): Volcom adopts Environmental Profit & Loss to reduce environmental impact
